grades.main_gap: The central stabilization lemma (only finitely many primes ever enter minimal hitting sets) is not proven—only a promised 'potential function' sketch; Lemma 2's monotonicity and 'no new primes' claims are also hand-waved. This is the core of the problem.
grades.notes: Sections 1–4 give a correct framework: valid integers are exactly those containing a stabilized minimal hitting set, a periodic set, and greedy enumeration then yields a_{n+T}=a_n+L correctly. But everything hinges on the unproven stabilization (admitted in Open Issues 4). Section 5's explicit classification is speculative and unneeded.
